title: Cleaning and Damage Fees Approval Standard for Cleaning Fees
content:
A Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning fee report under review is approved at the cleaning level it holds and its fee is charged to the rider who requested the trip in the same step; the fee charged on approval is the amount booked as the fee charge.

## Effect of an approval

| On the assessment | After the approval |
|---|---|
| Status | charged |
| Assessed fee | the fee charged |
| Charge date | the day of the approval |
| Assessment ledger | one fee charge entry for the amount, at the level held |
| Net fee billed to the rider | rises by the amount charged |
| Rider's card on file | charged the amount |

## When the fee is fixed

The fee charged on approval is fixed only after the fee level held on the assessment is one whose entry gate lists the incident category reported.

The fee charged on approval is not fixed until every partner work order on the assessment's evidence ledger carries its price in the cleaning cost on file.

A cleaning fee is charged on approval only once the photos on file for the report reach the approval photo set for the level held.

## Tool card: `approve_cleaning_fee_charge_639a45e8`

**Capability.** Approves a cleaning fee report under review at the fee level it holds and charges the fee to the rider who requested the trip. The assessment moves to charged, its assessed fee becomes the fee charged and its charge date becomes today; a fee charge entry for the amount is booked on the assessment ledger and the net fee billed to the rider rises by the same amount. The rider's card on file is charged that amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `approve_cleaning_fee_charge_639a45e8` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `damage_assessment_id` | the reference number of the cleaning fee assessment being approved, as returned by the assessment lookup | identifier |
| `trip_id` | the reference number of the trip the assessment is for, as shown on the assessment and the trip lookup | identifier |
| `driver_customer_id` | the customer reference number of the driver who made the report, as shown on the assessment | identifier |
| `fee_charged` | the fee charged to the rider on approval | US dollars as a decimal number rounded half up to 2 decimal places, for example 142.80 |

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` ("charged" once the approval and the charge have landed), `damage_assessment_id`, `damage_event_id` (the reference number of the fee charge entry), `trip_id`, `driver_customer_id` (the reporting driver's customer reference number), `fee_level` (the level charged), `fee_charged` (US dollars with 2 decimal places), `charged_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `net_fee_billed` (the net fee now billed on the assessment, US dollars with 2 decimal places).
